blocks.text: The Matsqui Abbotsford IMPACT Society is a non-profit organization with major funding from the Fraser Health Authority and significant funding from the Province of British Columbia. Special activities and projects are also generously funded by numerous Abbotsford, Mission and Fraser Valley area service organizations, as well as through donations from corporate foundations and concerned individuals and businesses. Our clinical staff members all hold certifications as addictions counsellors from accredited educational institutions, and they receive regular clinical supervision, as well as on-going professional development and training throughout the year. The Society’s board of directors consists for professionals with diverse backgrounds and both personal and professional ties to the vision and mission of the IMPACT Society.
